OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID

## Summary

I added a single new file, `OwnerUniqueHouseholdAdvice.java`, a self-contained `@ControllerAdvice` that rejects owner creation when another owner has the same `lastName` and `address`.

**Behavior:**
- Compares `lastName` and `address` case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace (`trim` + collapse runs of whitespace + lowercase).
- On a match, throws a small exception mapped to **409 Conflict**.
- Skips the check when the request body sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

**Why this shape (low structural impact):**
- I modeled it directly on the existing `OwnerUniqueTelephoneAdvice`, so the rule lives as its own cohesive unit instead of growing the controller, service, or another handler.
- `sharesHousehold` isn't a stored owner field (not in the OpenAPI `OwnerFields` schema / generated DTO), so I read the raw body once in `beforeBodyRead`, parse it to a `JsonNode` for the three values I need, run the check, and re-wrap the buffered bytes so normal deserialization proceeds unchanged.
- **One file touched, all methods brand-new** in a fresh class (so `WMC_other` starts at zero), each method kept short and low-complexity — minimizing the `max(WMC_other,1) * CC * changed_lines × files` cost.

All tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`), including the three acceptance cases: reject same lastName+address, allow different address, and allow with `sharesHousehold=true`.
